ghoul.intro: Ghoul sheet, V5 (read-only). Rules: core p. 234, Players Guide pp. 140–142.
ghoul.healing: Heals twice as fast as a mortal, except fire (Players Guide p. 142). No Hunger, no Blood Potency.
ghoul.powerNote: No Rouse Checks: a power above level 1 costs 1 Aggravated (core p. 234).
ghoul.strengthNotSet: Bond Strength not set (the Storyteller sets it)
ghoul.lastFed: Last fed on the domitor's Blood
ghoul.feedingRule: A Rouse Check's worth of the domitor's Blood keeps a ghoul about a month (core p. 234). No vitae track, no Hunger.

classicGhoul.intro: Ghoul sheet, Classic (Revised), read-only. Rules: Revised pp. 275–276, Ghouls: Fatal Addiction.
classicGhoul.poolRule: Spend a point to heal a level or to raise a Physical Attribute (up to twice the original); Disciplines need at least one point; soaks lethal damage while holding vitae. No Hunger, no Rouse Checks.
classicGhoul.lastFed: Last fed on the domitor's vitae
classicGhoul.frenzyRule: Frenzy: Self-Control, at difficulties two lower than a vampire's (Revised p. 276), never more dice than Blood Points held.
